europe_now.title: Norway seizes Russian ship over Ukraine compensation
europe_now.summary: Norway has seized a Russian vessel located in Svalbard to help fund compensation claims for Ukraine. The action highlights ongoing regional tensions and enforcement measures regarding the conflict.

sources.headline: Norway seizes Russian ship in Svalbard to compensate Ukraine

europe_now.title: Outrage in Malta following journalist murder acquittal
europe_now.summary: Public outrage has erupted across Malta after a controversial court acquittal related to the assassination of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. European officials have condemned the verdict and vowed to continue pursuing justice.

sources.headline: European Parliament’s Metsola on Daphne Caruana Galizia verdict: ‘We will not give up, we will not give in’
Outrage mounts in Malta after acquittal over journalist's murder

top_stories.title: SpaceX and Blue Origin withdraw from French summit
top_stories.summary: Major American aerospace companies SpaceX and Blue Origin have pulled out of a prominent space summit hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron. The withdrawals follow direct pressure from the White House regarding the event.

sources.headline: SpaceX, Blue Origin ditch Macron’s space summit after White House pressure

top_stories.title: Franco-British talks on migration and ties
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron met with UK leadership in London to discuss strengthening bilateral relations. The discussions focused heavily on scaling up joint actions to address small boat crossings and border security.

sources.headline: Burnham and Macron discuss small boats and bringing UK closer to Europe
